localPhrase.original: Bonjour, je découvre Bruxelles à pied.
localPhrase.transliteration: Bon-zhoor, zhuh day-koovr Bruh-sel ah pyay.
localPhrase.gloss: Hello, I am discovering Brussels on foot.
localPhrase.pronunciation: bon-ZHOOR, zhuh day-KOOVR bruh-SEL ah PYAY

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: Bonjour. Did you find your way from the station?

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: Yes. The streets are opening up ahead.

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: The galleries and the Grand-Place are close to the centre.

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: I would like to see both on foot.

dialogue.speaker: npc
dialogue.text: There is room to pause in the parks too.

dialogue.speaker: traveler
dialogue.text: Then I will take the day one place at a time.

notebookLines: The covered gallery held a quieter kind of city light.
Grand-Place opened into a broad square of detailed facades.
At Sainte-Catherine, the route slowed beside empty terraces.
The Marolles lane felt smaller after the big square.
Sablon brought stone facades and another open place to cross.
Mont des Arts made a pause before the long park paths.
The Atomium marked the last view of the day.
voteBlurb: Galleries, squares and park paths across Brussels, ending with the Atomium.

postcard.title: A day across Brussels
postcard.copy: Ten places later, the route reached the Atomium in the evening light.
